app.title: SPC
app.subtitle: Statistical process control after AIAG-VDA SPC Manual (2026)
app.notice: Reference build: it follows the Yellow Volume draft (Feb 2026). Data, marks and reports are stored in the database and shared by all signed-in users.
import.title: Import a CSV file
import.intro: Choose a file, check the columns, then import. Excel files saved as CSV (UTF-8 or Big5) are read correctly.
import.missing_skip: Skip the row and note it
issue.encoding: The file cannot be decoded as UTF-8 or Big5.
issue.duplicate_header: Two columns have the same name.
issue.missing_column: A chosen column is not in the file.
issue.bad_number: The value is not a number. Check the decimal mark.
issue.bad_timestamp: The date and time is not in a known format.
issue.bad_flag: The valid flag is not understood.
issue.invalid_without_reason: A value marked invalid needs a reason.
issue.bad_source_row: The original row number is not a number.
issue.no_data: The file has no data rows.
data.title: Data and outliers
data.select_hint: Tick rows to mark or restore them.
data.suspects_note: A hint is not a reason. A test only shows that a value does not fit the assumed distribution. Mark a value only when you know why it cannot come from the process, for example a wrong measurement or a calibration part. Marked values stay in the data and are left out of all calculations.
data.suspects_found: {n} suspect value(s). They are highlighted in the table.
data.reason_hint: Why can this value not come from the investigated process?
analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.stage_production: Production: performance or capability (Pp/Ppk or Cp/Cpk)
analysis.subgroup_size: Subgroup size (for data without subgroup labels)
analysis.model_A2: A2: constant, not normal (for example roundness)
analysis.model_C3: C3: location trend (for example tool wear)
analysis.model_C4: C4: systematic and random (for example lot change)
analysis.model_hint: Only A1 and A2 are in statistical control. Without a model, results are named Pp/Ppk.
analysis.controlled_stable: The process is controlled stable: values stay inside the limits and well inside the tolerance, and operators monitor and adjust it by procedure.
analysis.mode_random_range: Allow the alarms that chance explains (draft)
analysis.rules_hint: Each extra criterion finds special causes sooner and also raises the false alarm rate. Switch on only what the process needs.
analysis.rule_run: Run on one side of the center line, points:
analysis.rule_middle_third: Middle third (25 points: fewer than 11 or more than 23 inside)
analysis.rule_two_of_three: 2 of 3 beyond 2 sigma on one side
analysis.rule_four_of_five: 4 of 5 beyond 1 sigma on one side
analysis.incomplete: Subgroups that lost values to invalid marks
analysis.incomplete_drop: Leave them out and list them
analysis.customer: Customer or parameter set name (kept with the result)
result.title: Result
result.no_spec_on_chart: Specification limits are not drawn on control charts.
result.class_not_tested: Not tested in a machine study
result.alarm_points: Alarm points: {n} of {k} points checked, {expected} expected by chance, {threshold} allowed
result.names_reason_machine: Machine performance study: stability is not tested.
result.names_reason_preliminary: Preliminary study: stability cannot be proven yet.
result.names_reason_stable: Stability is proven, so the capability name applies.
result.names_reason_not_proven: Stability is not proven, so the performance name applies.
result.target_adjusted: Targets are raised for the smaller sample.
result.target_blocked: A critical characteristic needs the full sample of {base}. No reduced target exists.
result.verdict_meets: Met, also at the lower confidence limit
result.verdict_meets_estimate_only: Estimate met, lower confidence limit below target
result.diagnosis_note: Cw/Cwk use only the variation inside subgroups. They are for analysis and must not go into reports. A Cwk far above Ppk or Cpk points to variation between subgroups.
warn.data_subgroup_not_contiguous: Subgroup {label} is not in one block in the file.
warn.data_time_not_ordered: The timestamps are not in time order. Subgroups follow the file order.
warn.data_rows_skipped: {count} row(s) with an empty value were skipped.
warn.attribute_small_sample: Sample size is at or below {limit}. Small changes may stay unseen.
warn.attribute_size_varies: Sample size varies by 25 % or more. Limits change from point to point.
warn.edition_final_unverified: The release edition rules were not checked against a primary source. Check the targets with the handbook.
warn.dropped_subgroups: {count} subgroup(s) were left out because values were marked invalid: {labels}.
warn.few_subgroups: Only {k} subgroups. The handbook asks for at least 25.
warn.sample_below_base: {n} values is below the base sample size {base}. Targets and intervals are less certain.
warn.named_pp_not_cp: Named Pp/Ppk because stability is not proven. Choose the time-dependent model to claim Cp/Cpk.
warn.spec_missing: No specification limit given. Only the control charts are shown.
warn.non_normal: The data do not look normal ({test}, p = {p_value}). These indices assume a normal distribution. Methods for non-normal data are not available yet.
warn.one_sided_no_p: One-sided specification: only the location index is given.
warn.target_not_allowed: No reduced target for a critical characteristic with {n} values. {base} are needed.
tools.title: Tools
tools.arl_max: Must be caught within this many subgroups (optional)
tools.arl_required: Smallest subgroup size that meets it
tools.arl_none: No subgroup size up to 1000 meets it.
error.import_failed: The file could not be imported.
error.incomplete_subgroups: {count} subgroup(s) lost values to invalid marks: {labels}. Allow leaving them out, or restore the values.
error.positions_out_of_range: Some selected rows do not exist.
error.already_invalid: Some selected values are already marked invalid.
error.not_invalid: Some selected values are not marked invalid.
error.dataset_not_found: This dataset does not exist (any more). It may have been deleted. Open another one under “Saved”.
error.file_too_large: The file is larger than {limit_mb} MB.
error.sizes_required: Sample sizes are required for this chart.
error.no_value_column: Choose the column with the measured values.
report.title: Report
report.intro: Make the 20+2 element report of this analysis. The report is a snapshot: later changes to the data do not change a report that already exists. The first fields fill the report elements 1 to 10 and 20 to 22.
report.persons: People who performed the study and measurements
report.period_text: Time of data collection (used when the data has no time stamps)
report.deviations: Deviations from stable operating conditions (environment, settings, cycle time)
report.sampling_frequency: Sampling frequency (used when the data has no time stamps)
report.uncertainty: Expanded measurement uncertainty U (for the guard band)
report.pdf_hint: To get a PDF, open the report and use the print function of the browser (A4).
report.needs_run: Run the analysis first. The report uses the same settings.
tools.archive_intro: Checks that the content was not changed and runs the calculation again from the stored data and parameters.
archive.integrity_bad: The content was changed after the archive was made (the digest does not match).
archive.reproduced_yes: The calculation gives the stored result again.
archive.reproduced_no: The calculation gives a different result:
archive.other_engine: The archive was made with another software version.
error.report_needs_spec: A report needs at least one specification limit.
error.archive_unreadable: The file is not a readable archive.
login.title: Sign in
login.setup_needed: No user exists yet. An administrator creates the first one on the server: spc-admin create-user NAME --role admin
login.session_ended: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
password.title: Change password
password.forced: You must choose a new password before you can continue.
password.rules: At least {min} characters, not your user name.
password.done: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
saved.title: Saved data and reports
saved.intro: Everything is stored in the database and shared by all users. Reports are snapshots and stay as they were made.
saved.confirm_delete: Delete dataset “{name}”? Reports made from it are kept.
admin.title: Administration
admin.reset_prompt: New temporary password for {name} (at least 10 characters):
admin.reset_done: Password of {name} was reset. They must change it at the next sign-in.
admin.unlocked: {name} can try to sign in again.
admin.created: User {name} created. They must change the password at the first sign-in.
admin.audit_note: Every sign-in, mark, report and user change is listed here and linked by a hash chain. A changed or removed entry breaks the chain. A cut-off end is only seen when you compare the last hash with one you kept elsewhere.
data.person_note: Marks are recorded under your sign-in: {user}.
error.csrf_failed: The request was refused for safety. Reload the page and sign in again.
error.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this. It needs the role: {role}.
error.invalid_credentials: User name or password is wrong.
error.login_locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {minutes} min, or ask an administrator to unlock the name.
error.username_invalid: User names have 3–64 characters: letters, digits, . _ @ -
error.last_admin: This is the last active administrator. Make another one first.
error.password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
error.password_too_short: The password needs at least {min} characters.
error.password_too_long: The password may have at most {max} characters.
error.password_is_username: The password may not be the user name.
error.password_too_simple: The password is too simple. Use more different characters.
analysis.distribution_hint: For a normal distribution the indices use the total standard deviation. For other data, fit a distribution: the indices then come from its quantiles (.G) or from the shares outside the limits (.Z). Choose with knowledge of the process. Automatic choice only helps.
analysis.bootstrap: Bootstrap resamples for the interval (0 = no interval)
analysis.seed: Random seed of the bootstrap (kept with the result)
result.dist_boot: Interval: bootstrap, {used} of {requested} resamples used, seed {seed}.
result.dist_boot_failed: No interval: only {used} of {requested} resamples could be fitted.
result.dist_no_boot: No interval: the bootstrap is switched off. A target is judged on the estimate alone.
result.dist_cand_note: Smaller AIC fits better. AIC and Anderson-Darling describe the fit. They are no pass/fail tests, because the parameters come from the same data. A normal distribution within 2 AIC units of the best wins the automatic choice.
result.dist_ranked_sample: The families were ranked on a random sample of {n} values. The chosen one was fitted on all values.
warn.bootstrap_failed: The interval could not be computed: only {succeeded} of {requested} resamples could be fitted. The target is judged on the estimate alone.
warn.fit_small_sample: Only {n} values: the tail quantiles (0.135 % and 99.865 %) of a fitted distribution are extrapolated and uncertain.
data.restart_note: After a tool change or an action that followed an alarm, the moving characteristics of an I-MR chart must start again. Otherwise the old values cause more alarms although the process is corrected. Select the first value after the event and give the reason above. A moving range never spans a restart. The restart is stored with your sign-in.
data.restart_list: Restarts before the values with No.: {rows}
analysis.moving_hint: 1 = individual values. A larger size plots moving means. After the start and after every restart the size grows 1, 2, … up to this value, so there is no blind spot.
result.moving_line: Individuals chart with moving sample size {n} and {k} restart(s) (dotted lines). The limits follow the size of the moving sample.
warn.restarts_not_used: {n} restart(s) in the data are not used. Only the I-MR chart restarts.
warn.restart_without_effect: {n} restart(s) have no effect: there is no valid value before or after them in the data used.
error.restart_at_start: A restart before the first value has no effect.
error.already_restart: There is a restart before this value already.
error.not_restart: There is no restart before this value.
data.restart_phase: New limits from here: the process was changed on purpose. The centre line and the limits are calculated again from the values after this point. Leave it off when the process is the same and only the moving sample must start again.
result.phase_line: Phase {k}, from file row {from}: {n} values, centre line {mu}, σ̂ {sigma}
analysis.profile_hint: A profile fixes the settings that the customer agreed on: they are applied by the program and cannot be changed here. The report then uses the layout of the profile.
analysis.profile_line: Profile {name}, revision {rev}. Fixed by the profile: {keys}.
report.extra_title: Information required by the customer profile
admin.profiles_note: A profile holds the analysis settings and the report layout of one customer. Everybody can use a profile. Only administrators change them. A change raises the revision number. A report keeps its own copy of the profile it used.
admin.profile_confirm_delete: Delete the customer profile “{name}”? Reports that were made with it keep their own copy.
admin.pf_analysis: Analysis settings fixed by the customer agreement
admin.pf_blank: Leave a field empty to keep the program's default.
admin.pf_alpha: Risk α of the control limits (two-sided)
admin.pf_est: Confidence of the interval of an index
admin.pf_targets: Target values (p and pk) per stage and characteristic class. Empty cells keep the draft's example values. Give both numbers of a cell.
admin.pf_logo: Logo (PNG or JPEG, at most 150 KB)
admin.pf_lang_any: As chosen when the report is made
admin.pf_el22: Show element 22 (measurement uncertainty and guard band)
admin.pf_required: Fields that the author must fill
admin.pf_extra: Extra fields of the customer (asked when the report is made)
error.profile_not_found: This customer profile does not exist (any more).
error.profile_name_taken: A customer profile with this name exists already.
error.report_field_required: The customer profile requires these fields: {fields}
error.report_field_unknown: These extra fields do not belong to the customer profile: {fields}
error.profile_targets_pair: Give both targets of a cell (p and pk), or leave both empty.
mon.title: SPC at the line (control loop 1)
mon.intro: An SPC monitor controls the process directly. Its limits are fixed. Every new sample is checked at once, and every violation must be followed by the out-of-control action plan. Specification limits are not part of this chart.
mon.alerts_line: Open incidents: {open} (not yet taken over: {unack}, overdue: {overdue})
mon.f_warn: Risk of the warning limits (empty = no warning limits)
mon.f_source: Where the first limits come from
mon.src_sigma: Standard deviation of the individual values
mon.specs_note: The chart at the line never shows these limits. They are used for the ongoing report, which belongs to the higher control loops.
mon.f_rules: Stability criteria besides the control limits
mon.ocap_note: What the operator does when a criterion is violated, who is responsible, and who is called when nothing helps. A criterion without its own row uses the default row. A change of the plan has to be confirmed again by everybody.
mon.f_require_ack: Everybody must confirm that they know the action plan before entering samples
mon.ack_needed: You have not yet confirmed that you know the action plan. This is the plan:
mon.label: Label (lot, part no.)
mon.result_ok: Sample {seq}: within the limits. Go on.
mon.result_warning: Sample {seq}: inside the control limits, but beyond a warning limit. Watch the next samples.
mon.result_alarm: Sample {seq}: OUT OF CONTROL. Follow the action plan.
mon.verification_note: This sample was taken during an open incident. It counts as verification.
mon.next_step: First measure again or take a second sample to make sure that the sample is valid.
mon.no_spec_note: Specification limits are not shown here on purpose: at the line the control limits count.
mon.invalidate_prompt: Why is sample {seq} invalid (for example: gauge not zeroed)?
mon.not_taken_over: nobody has taken it over yet
mon.overdue: OVERDUE: not escalated {min} minutes after the violation
mon.outcome_recovered: control is back (needs a new sample that meets all criteria)
mon.outcome_escalated: handed to the root cause analysis
mon.limits_now: Limits revision {rev}. Mean {mu}, standard deviation {sigma}. Lower limit / centre / upper limit:
mon.new_limits_note: Do this when the process location or variation changed through control or improvement, or when the review says the limits do not fit. The limits stay fixed afterwards. The criteria start again from the next sample.
mon.ongoing_note: The index of the latest samples, calculated like an analysis chart. Stability decides whether it is called performance or capability. Here the specification limits are used.
mon.ongoing_report: Make a report of this window
mon.og_targets: Targets: p {p}, pk {pk}. Verdict for pk: {verdict}
mon.og_no_spec: The monitor has no specification limits, so no index is given.
mon.quadrant_2: Quadrant II: performing but not stable
mon.quadrant_3: Quadrant III: stable but the targets are missed
mon.quadrant_4: Quadrant IV: not stable and the targets are missed
mon.quadrant_unknown: No quadrant: there are no targets to judge by (give the characteristic class and the limits).
mon.quadrant_note: Quadrants I to IV follow figure 10-26 of the draft. Only I fulfils stability and capability.
mon.review_ok: The limits fit the data (spread {ratio} times the spread behind the limits, {alarms} alarm samples, {expected} expected).
mon.review_too_narrow: The limits look too narrow (spread {ratio} times the spread behind the limits, {alarms} alarm samples, {expected} expected). Too narrow limits cause over-regulation. Consider new limits.
mon.review_too_wide: The limits look too wide (spread {ratio} times the spread behind the limits). Real changes may stay unnoticed. Consider new limits.
mon.review_location_moved: The location has moved by {shift} standard errors from the centre line. If this is the new normal, set new limits with a reason.
mon.og_response: Response of the action plan: {n} incidents ({open} open, {overdue} overdue). Median time to take over: {ack}, to the first action: {action}, to close: {close}.
error.wrong_value_count: This monitor takes {n} value(s) per sample. Fill them all in.
error.ocap_not_acknowledged: Confirm first that you know the action plan of this monitor.
error.no_limits: This monitor has no limits yet.
error.bad_time: The time of the sample is not a date and time.
error.time_in_future: The time of the sample lies in the future.
error.bad_source: The source of the limits cannot be used: {message}
error.monitor_shape_locked: The chart type, the sample size and the risk cannot change. Make a new monitor, or set new limits.
error.text_required: Write what was done, or the result.
error.already_acknowledged: Somebody has taken this over already.
error.sample_still_valid: Declare the sample invalid on its row first, with a reason.
error.verification_missing: Enter a new sample after the last action. It must meet all criteria.
error.escalation_missing: Log the escalation or the start of the root cause analysis first.
error.not_enough_points: There are not enough valid samples yet (at least 10).
error.monitor_not_found: This monitor does not exist (any more).
error.monitor_name_taken: A monitor with this name exists already.
result.kind_p: p chart – share of nonconforming units
result.kind_np: np chart – number of nonconforming units
mon.src_rate_value: Reference level (p-bar for p and np, per unit for c and u)
mon.src_counts_list: Counts of at least 20 reference samples, separated by spaces or commas
mon.src_sizes_list: Sample sizes of the same samples, in the same order
mon.limits_now_count: Limits revision {rev}. Reference level {center}. Lower limit / centre line / upper limit of the latest sample:
mon.limits_per_size: The limits are exact (binomial or Poisson) and follow the size of each sample.
error.report_not_for_attribute: Counts have no capability report: it needs measured values.
